title: Test the connection to the WSUS server
description: Check the configuration of and the connectivity to the WSUS server

windowsCommandTemplate.name: Test-NetConnection
windowsCommandTemplate.commandPattern: powershell -Command "$WUServer = (Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).WUServer; if ($WUServer) { Write-Host 'WSUS Server: ' $WUServer; Test-NetConnection -ComputerName ($WUServer -replace 'http://|https://|/' -split ':')[0] -Port 8530 } else { Write-Host 'No WSUS server configured' }"

notes: Checks the registry configuration and tests network connectivity. Port 8530 = HTTP, 8531 = HTTPS.
